headlines.title_en: US imposes tariffs of 10%-12.5% on 60 economies
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 24: The U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announced on July 23 local time, citing Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, that it will impose tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on dozens of countries and regions under the pretext of 'forced labor,' replacing the soon-to-expire global import tariffs. The new tariffs will take effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on July 24 (12:00 p.m. Beijing Time on July 24). The USTR stated that as the 10% global tariffs expire, this round will target 60 economies, covering more than 99% of U.S. trade volume. Senior U.S. officials said that tariff measures on goods in transit will take effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on July 28 (12:00 p.m. Beijing Time on July 28). headlines.title_en: Japan becomes net importer of petrochemicals due to naphtha price surge
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 24: According to Nikkei, due to disruptions in crude-derived naphtha supply caused by the Iran war, Japan's imports of basic petrochemical raw materials used in products like plastics have surged, sourcing cost-effectively from China and South Korea. Trade data show that from March to May this year, Japan's ethylene imports rose 14-fold year-on-year. Imports of butadiene, a synthetic rubber raw material, increased more than threefold, while benzene imports surged over 28-fold. Meanwhile, exports of these products fell, with ethylene exports nearly dropping to zero in May. Japan's petrochemical trade pattern has reversed, with imports exceeding exports. According to the Japan Petrochemical Industry Association, Japan's ethylene imports exceeded exports by 19,000 tons in April and 15,000 tons in May, marking the first monthly ethylene import surplus since comparable data began in 2000.

headlines.summary: 周四（7月23日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率涨6.9个基点，报5.104%，北京时间19:00以来加速上涨、23:32达到5.122%。 两年期英债收益率涨6.8个基点，报4.490%，23:32也刷新日高至4.507%。 30年期英债收益率涨5.1个基点，50年期英债收益率涨3.3个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差涨0.246个基点，报+61.427个基点。

headlines.title_en: UK 2/10-year gilt yields rise about 7 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Thursday (July 23) European afternoon close: UK 10-year gilt yield rose 6.9 bps to 5.104%, accelerating from 19:00 Beijing time, hitting 5.122% at 23:32. Two-year yield rose 6.8 bps to 4.490%, also hitting a daily high of 4.507% at 23:32. 30-year yield rose 5.1 bps, 50-year yield rose 3.3 bps. 2/10-year yield spread rose 0.246 bps to +61.427 bps.
